data.name: Sharulaksha
data.gender_notes: Sharulaksha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharulaksha is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Sharu meaning 'knowledge' and Akshi meaning 'eye'. This name signifies the Goddess of Knowledge and Protection, who is believed to bestow wisdom and shield her devotees from harm. The name Sharulaksha carries the meaning “Goddess of Knowledge and Protection” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharulaksha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharulaksha is a divine name that represents the power of knowledge and protection. It is believed to invoke the blessings of the Goddess of Wisdom and Providence, who is believed to protect her devotees and guide them towards the path of knowledge and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Sharulaksha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Knowledge and Protection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharulaksha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
